summary.zh: agent-pack：reconcile --retire-plugin 退役插件时一并清理各客户端的入口：Claude 指向该插件的用户级 Skill 链接，Codex 个人市场条目与插件副本（先归档到 recovery 再移除，预览逐项列出）；出于安全不自动处理的项（Claude MCP 条目与安装记录、Codex 缓存其它版本与 config.toml）在输出的 residuals 中列出并给出手工步骤。
summary.en: agent-pack: reconcile --retire-plugin now also cleans every client entry of the retired plugin: Claude user-level Skill links pointing into it, and the Codex personal marketplace entry and plugin copy (archived to recovery first; the preview lists each step). Entries that are not cleaned automatically for safety (Claude MCP entries and install record, other Codex cache versions, config.toml) are listed under residuals with a manual step.
